findings.summary: The hero banner gradient hardcodes hex colors Color(0xFF0A1830) and Color(0xFF104D78) instead of deriving from Theme brand/accent, breaking the color contract and dark-theme adaptability.
findings.fix: Replace the LinearGradient colors with theme-derived shades, e.g. colors: [scheme.primary, scheme.secondary] read from Theme.of(context).colorScheme, matching brand 0xFF0B4FA2 / accent 0xFF00A8D6 rather than one-off hex values.

findings.summary: The banner icon uses a hardcoded Color(0xFFB9ECFF) instead of an on-brand theme color, an ad-hoc hue not in the palette.
findings.fix: Use a theme-based color such as scheme.onPrimary or scheme.secondary.withValues(alpha: .9) instead of the literal Color(0xFFB9ECFF).

findings.summary: The hero banner uses borderRadius 25, deviating from the established card radius of 20.
findings.fix: Change BorderRadius.circular(25) to BorderRadius.circular(20) to match the design-system card radius.

findings.summary: The status filter is a bespoke horizontal ChoiceChip row that omits the MobileFilterBar result label and clear-filters affordance.
findings.fix: Replace the bespoke SingleChildScrollView/_filterChip row (lines 166-177, 234-241) with MobileFilterBar, or at minimum add a result-count label and a clear/reset control, passing status options and a resultLabel like 'عدد التقارير: ${filtered.length}'.

findings.summary: The header banner is a fully bespoke container and does not surface the association BrandLogo/BrandLogoMark anywhere on this executive page.
findings.fix: Add a BrandLogoMark (from lib/core/widgets/brand_logo.dart) in the banner alongside the analytics icon for consistent executive branding.

findings.summary: The report card trailing icon (chevron/download-done) conveys file-availability state but has no tooltip or Semantics label for screen readers.
findings.fix: Wrap the trailing Icon in Semantics(label: item.storagePath == null ? 'لا يوجد ملف' : 'الملف جاهز للتنزيل', child: ...) or add a Tooltip so the state is announced.

findings.summary: The bottom-sheet summary uses bare Material Chip widgets with default styling inconsistent with the app's radius-99 chip and status-pill conventions.
findings.fix: Style the summary Chips to the design system (StadiumBorder / radius 99, theme surfaceContainerHighest background) or reuse a shared pill widget.

findings.summary: The error and loading states use bare centered icons/spinners without a BrandLogo header and the error icon lacks a theme error color.
findings.fix: Tint the cloud_off icon with scheme.error and consider adding a BrandLogoMark header to the error/loading ListViews for consistency with other screens.
